slides.title: Five paid sick days a year, and a doctor's cert from day one
slides.sub: What the law gives every employee, in four numbers.

slides.title: paid sick leave per year
slides.body: That is the legal minimum. Your contract can give you more. It can't give you less.

slides.title: of your normal pay, capped at €110 a day
slides.card: Earn €200 a day? 70% would be €140, so the cap applies and you get **€110**.

slides.title: of continuous work with your employer
slides.body: Before that, statutory sick pay doesn't apply yet. Check your contract for anything extra.

slides.title: a doctor should certify you from your first sick day
slides.body: No cert, no statutory sick pay. Sort it out on day one, not day three.

slides.title: Did you know about the €110 daily cap before today?
slides.body: Yes or no in the comments. We read every one.
slides.source: Source: Citizens Information, "Sick leave and sick pay" (citizensinformation.ie). General information, not legal advice.
